approved_scope: Owner-approved read-only Go adapter with full offline CycloneDX JSON 1.7 Draft 7 validation. No HTTP/UI, normalization, authoritative import or new execution boundary. Persistent import interruption/recovery explicitly deferred by the owner to a task with that workflow.
source_identity_method: SHA-256 of sorted relative-path + NUL + per-file SHA-256 hex + newline records (UTF-8).
source_identity_scope: All current Go engine/library/tests and synthetic fixture files; embedded schemas/provenance, C10 licenses, module/npm/toolchain locks, C10 task, roadmap, execution/architecture/reference documents and engine discovery. Excludes evidence, progress/requirements/project-state, handoff, generated projection and dependency/build/cache outputs to avoid self-reference.
providers: None invoked. No OPA, Syft, Grype or external service is required by this adapter.

cyclonedx.acquisition: Four unchanged schema members read from the existing C02 source archive only after rechecking its pinned SHA-256; no extraction paths supplied by input.
